reviews.text: Good prices compared to Mexico, and above all, the level of customer service and friendliness is unbeatable; the girl who helped us was very kind.

I think it's good for regulars and familiar customers.
I came alone because I wanted to look at the beds.
The first female staff member who spoke to me called me over, and another female staff member who came out from the back was very kind to me despite being busy (though I still got the feeling she wanted to finish quickly).
However, the staff member who handled my payment (the first one who spoke to me) was really unfriendly, and I decided I didn't want to come back.
She was friendly to the regulars, so I suppose that's just the kind of person she is, but the very end left a bad impression, and I felt like I wouldn't want to go back unless it was for a very good reason.
I visit every month for grooming and to get advice on food, and they are true professionals.

Great real pet store with decent selection of products for dogs. After visiting 2 other stores, we were happy to find this one. They had very good selection of raincoats for medium and larger dogs, good collars, good toys, good selection of hair treatments, and excellent service - patient and professional.
Decent prices and very good value for your money.
Highly recommend.

I visited for the first time today, and the staff member was very kind and friendly. He was a man, but his smile and dedication were evident, and I definitely want to go back.

I was a little nervous because I had read some negative reviews in previous posts, but I was relieved!

Thank you!
They explained everything about dog food to me very thoroughly.

I visited a dog boutique and was pleasantly surprised! There were so many beautiful clothes and accessories. I bought a few dresses for my girl pup and some shirts for my boy. The quality is excellent – definitely worth stopping by. The store is quite small, but it’s very cozy and pleasant to visit. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for something cute and high-quality for their pets!

Given its location, this is a very rare pet shop!
They have a wide selection of supplies.
They even have frozen birthday cakes and treat food, so it's helpful if you forget to buy something or suddenly need it.
(There are samples in the display window at the register, which is great!)♪
The staff were also cheerful and polite!
It's not in the main Mitsukoshi building, but in the annex across the street.
There's an elevator next to the bicycle parking area, so use that to go to the 2nd floor.

I visited the store over a three-day weekend. It was my first time.

In conclusion, I think it's a comfortable place for regular customers or those with pets.

I was there alone and wanted to ask a staff member about a product, but when our eyes met and I tried to speak to them, they quickly looked away and walked right past me. There were about three other customers in the same situation, so I thought they might be busy because it was the weekend, but other customers were actively greeting me with things like, "Hello, Mr./Ms. XX!" and "Oh! It's △△ (your dog's breed)! So cute!", so I was saddened by the difference in their attitude toward me.

I finally found a female staff member who was willing to talk to me, and she was the only one who treated me well. Thank you.

Also, on the day I visited, they were holding an event called "Pet Prints." When I had a brief conversation with the specialist staff member in charge, although at first glance she spoke in a gentle manner, I was annoyed by her dismissive responses when I expressed interest and asked a question... I didn't mean to, but she may have thought I was just looking around.

When it was time to pay, the male staff member muttered something so quietly that I couldn't hear some of it. When I asked him to repeat it, he gave me a visibly puzzled look and I left the store feeling sad again.

I plan to return at a later date to collect my item, but to be honest I'm scared and feeling very uneasy.

The store was clean and spacious, making shopping comfortable! 

I brought my 6-month-old puppy with me, and all the staff were very gracious. …
I inquired about dog clothes, and they even checked the stock status at other stores for me, which was incredibly helpful! …
Because the customer service reviews were mixed, I was a little wary before going in, but the service was actually polite and pleasant. …
